notes.title: vridniX - Patch v1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
vridniX is back, almost 4 years after the initial release with a big update on which we've worked those last 18 months. It's a patch that improves greatly the player experience, here's the details:

[u][b]Title Screen[/b][/u]
-A brand new title screen has been added, on which you can select the language, game mode and join the official Discord server
-A new music has been made for this title screen (and for a boss fight!) 

[u][b]Accessibility options added[/b][/u]
-Invincibility: vridniX cannot die
-Stop vridniX: by pressing a button, vridniX will stop running
-Infinite Jumps: you can jump as much as you want! (beware of the invisible walls...)
-vridniX' hidden power: by pressing a button, you can now use vridniX' hidden power anytime
-Change game speed: from 1 to 0.1 !

[u][b]Speedrun[/b][/u]
-A Speedrun gamemode has been added in the Title Screen
-Time recording and precision have been improved
-Added a "Training" options to restart levels as soon as you finished them
[i]WARNING: Due to changes in the save files, all players who started the game without finishing it before the update will have a time of 0h00m00.000 when they'll finish the game, sorry for the inconvenience![/i]

[u][b]Gameplay improvements[/b][/u]
-Removed randoms in all boss fights
-Jumps and backflips are more permissive now (less tight timings) 
-Improvement in some levels 
-Added a "Restart" options in the pause menu

[u][b]UI improvements[/b][/u]
-All menu have been reworked
-We removed the "progress menu" to replace it with a "level selection" menu, now available from level 1
-Added some icons in the level selection menu to show the player where the secrets are
-Secrets & Bonus menu improved a lot

[u][b]Graphics[/b][/u]
-Graphics assets added in a lot of levels
-General change of color to improve contrast
-Some animations improved

[u][b]Optimisation & bug fix[/b][/u]
-General optimisation to improve performance
-More than 100 bugs fixed (!!)

Thanks for reading through all of that! We now have an official Discord server, you can join it using this link: [url=https://discord.gg/bqSjgCm6Vv]vridniX Discord's Server[/url] 
We're preparing some more stuff so stay tuned!

notes.title: vridniX Coming to Steam on August 16th
notes.notes:
Well. We wanted to announce the official release day today but our plan got wrecked. We were hit by some weird three legged creature calling himself vridniX and claiming to be a hero! What sorcery is this!?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32269666/57a4141d3f6de61f69536184097d2bdf34c62028.png[/img]

Instead of the originally planned datet, we now follow the advice of the strange orange creature to report that the vridniX, a speedy and chaotic 2D platformer will hit Steam on [b]August 16th[/b]! Bringing a generous helping of salt and madness to Steam (He also forced us to mention something about a Neta-Vark? Some sort of place where the Wamnis live?), vridniX will challenge all comers.

And yes, ragequits will be real soon. Salt will be real. Thanks to everyone for the big support so far!

notes.title: Who is vridniX?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32269666/402fd0dc226cacd52b084a3bd78252371762fd8b.png[/img]

vridniX is the only one of his kind from an ancient species, the Naqqs. Reclusive and scornful, he always thought that he was destined for greatness. As he miraculously survived an ancient Cataclysm, he slept for 3000 years before being found.

vridniX is now awake and suffering from amnesia. He now lives amongst the Wamnis, but he doesn’t really like them. However he is very close to Venn, his best friend, who’s more cynical and less of a simpleton than other Wamnis. Venn is the only one who knows about vridniX' power, which is to rotate the world by catching special orbs.

The image is of the vridniX trading card. There will be 10 cards in total.

notes.title: Boss Highlight: Mother of Rouxbots
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/juXc40Y.gif][/img]
As the mother of all Rouxbots, she’s in charge of manufacturing the little AI bots of The Dimension world. All her creations will follow her commands, mainly to spread art across the whole of Neta-Vrak. An excellent goal for sure, but vridniX is having none of it and wreaks havoc across The Dimension and destroys many Rouxbots. The Mother will try and trap vridniX in a vault for eternity. Can you help him find a way to escape?

notes.title: World Highlight: The Cave
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/w1PnIOV.gif] [/img]
The Cave is a area about removing one critical sensory element, light. With only a limited amount of light to guide you, you will have to navigate and maneuver mostly in the dark. New to this world are spore-shooting stalactites, which use a straight-line projectile that emits light but also kills on contact. Proceed with caution!
